basis: The February 3, 2026 release verified the threshold crossing for fiscal Q1 2026. Consolidated GAAP net sales were $343,778,000 for the quarter ended December 27, 2025, versus $362,598,000 for the quarter ended December 28, 2024. That was $690,100 below the $344,468,100 cutoff. Both figures come from the same consolidated earnings table. The earliest public disclosure remains unresolved because the CEO presented company performance at ICR on January 12, after quarter-end, and I could not verify the full presentation or remarks.

coverage.detail: August 5, 2025, preceding earnings cycle. The fiscal Q3 release reported $454.3 million of net sales for the June quarter and gave no numeric consolidated sales bound for the December quarter.
The August 28 8-K identified exit or disposal costs and material impairments. Its filing index lists no earnings or guidance exhibit.

November 17, previous earnings release. The roughly 4% sales decline applied to fiscal Q4 2025, ended September 27. The $3 million to $5 million fiscal 2026 estimate covered closure and other charges. The release gave no fiscal Q1 consolidated revenue range.

November 17 call. In Q&A, the CEO estimated a 1% to 1.5% portfolio-optimization impact on sales, and the CFO expected the full run rate around Q2. Management described early Q1 performance qualitatively and gave no upper bound for total Q1 sales.

November 24 CEO interview. The softer-sales discussion concerned the reported fourth quarter. The CEO discussed plant consolidation, pretzel growth and upcoming launches without quantifying consolidated December-quarter sales.
The ICR organizer scheduled J&J Snack Foods for January 12, 2026 at 2:30 p.m. The agenda establishes the presentation date and contains no sales figures.

The CEO and the issuer confirmed his ICR appearance. The issuer said he covered strategy, performance and long-term growth priorities. Their recap gives no Q1 sales figure. I could not locate a readable deck, transcript or replay to determine whether he disclosed one during the session.
January 16 scheduling notice. J&J announced a February 3 premarket release and a 10 a.m. call. It supplied no preliminary sales or quarterly forecast.

February 3 actuals. The issuer reported a 5.2% decline. Its consolidated earnings table gives net sales of 343,778 versus 362,598 in thousands of dollars, and its segment table reconciles to those same consolidated totals.
EDGAR accepted the results 8-K with Exhibit 99.1 on February 3, 2026 at 07:01:41.
EDGAR accepted the December-quarter Form 10-Q on February 5, two days after the public results.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s results page and Exhibit 99.1 both carry a February 3, 2026 dateline, corroborated by same-day EDGAR acceptance. The USD value is the verified actual from that release. The January 12 ICR presentation leaves the earliest qualifying date unverified.
